standby.label: Standby
standby.trigger: The committee has not yet received a plan or is awaiting fresh figures.

calculating.label: Calculating
calculating.trigger: Deterministic TypeScript engines are computing R:R, BEP, DSR, and macro context.

skeptical.label: Skeptical
skeptical.trigger: Thin contribution margins, optimistic targets, or hidden Pre-Mortem gaps surface.

alarmed.label: Alarmed
alarmed.trigger: Severe flags fire: deficit cashflow, negative unit margin, or >3% capital risk.

conditional.label: Conditional
conditional.trigger: Score sits in the 50–74 zone; viable only if mandatory risk fixes are applied.

cleared.label: Cleared
cleared.trigger: All mathematical thresholds pass, score >= 75, and liquidity buffers hold.

data_analyst.standby: Feed me raw numbers. I do not judge on intuition—only verifiable ratios.
data_analyst.calculating: Cross-checking position metrics against live USD/IDR, IHSG, and today's macro regime...
data_analyst.skeptical: Your unit target clears break-even, yet the margin cushion is razor-thin under volatility.
data_analyst.alarmed: The math is unambiguous: debt service breaches 30% and monthly cashflow turns negative.
data_analyst.conditional: Mathematically survivable, provided you add at least two months of extra cash buffer.
data_analyst.cleared: Risk-to-reward above 1:2 verified. Capital exposure stays cleanly below the 2% ceiling.

risk_manager.standby: The moment your plan arrives, I assume it failed completely six months from today.
risk_manager.calculating: Stress-testing worst-case shocks: 50% sales drop, stop-loss slippage, and liquidity freeze...
risk_manager.skeptical: What is your exit protocol if both of these core assumptions break in month three?
risk_manager.alarmed: Full stop. A single unexpected bill or drawdown wipes out your operating liquidity.
risk_manager.conditional: Executable only with automated stop-losses and a tighter cap on fixed commitments.
risk_manager.cleared: Key failure modes are hedged. Even under severe stress, your liquidity reserve holds.

committee_chair.standby: The chamber is open. Submit your financial thesis for an unsentimental Pre-Mortem review.
committee_chair.calculating: Weighing quantitative ratios against Pre-Mortem blind spots before issuing the verdict...
committee_chair.skeptical: This thesis is under-prepared. Define your downside ceiling before deploying capital.
committee_chair.alarmed: Committee verdict: HOLD. Proceeding right now exposes your balance sheet to avoidable ruin.
committee_chair.conditional: Verdict: PROCEED WITH CONDITIONS. Execute the mandatory mitigation fix before committing.
committee_chair.cleared: Verdict: CLEARED. Your math discipline and liquidity buffer meet committee standards.
